result.instructions: Tools for Imweb, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders came in today and still wait for payment?"; "Show order 202611250001 with its items and delivery address."; "Which products are sold out right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Imweb data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run imweb_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run imweb_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run imweb_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. imweb_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: imweb_get_store
tools.title: Get store info
tools.description: Get the site's store details (shop name, domain, contact and business info). Imweb API: GET /v2/shop/store.

tools.name: imweb_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the shop's products, optionally filtered by category code or status (sale, soldout, nosale). Full-list read: Imweb allows 1 such call per second per site. Imweb API: GET /v2/shop/products.

prod_status.description: Product status: sale, soldout or nosale (hidden).

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Paged replies include pagination data.

tools.name: imweb_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by its product number (no), with price, stock, images, options and discounts. Imweb API: GET /v2/shop/products/{no}.

tools.name: imweb_list_categories
tools.title: List product categories
tools.description: List the shop's product categories with their codes. Use the codes to filter imweb_list_products. Imweb API: GET /v2/shop/categories.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Paged replies include pagination data.

tools.name: imweb_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (order system v2) filtered by order date, status or channel. Without dates, Imweb returns the last 3 months. Dates are Unix timestamps in seconds. Imweb API: GET /v2/shop/orders.

order_date_from.description: Order date start, Unix time in seconds.

order_date_to.description: Order date end, Unix time in seconds.

status.description: Order status, for example PAY_WAIT (awaiting payment), PAY_COMPLETE, STANDBY, DELIVERING. Use one status filter only.

type.description: Order channel: normal (Imweb), npay (Naver Pay), talkpay (KakaoTalk).

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Paged replies include pagination data.

tools.name: imweb_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order (order system v2) with its buyer, delivery address, payment and item order numbers (prod_order_no). Personal data: use it only for the order at hand. Imweb API: GET /v2/shop/orders/{order_no}.

tools.name: imweb_add_tracking_number
tools.title: Add a tracking number
tools.description: Write the carrier and tracking number for an order (order system v2), which marks its items as shipped. Imweb needs every item order number of the order. Imweb may notify the buyer. Imweb API: PATCH /v2/shop/orders/{order_no}/invoice.

parcel_code.description: Carrier code from Imweb's supported carrier list (지원 택배사).

prod_order_nos.description: Every item order number (prod_order_no) of the order; Imweb rejects a partial list.

tools.name: imweb_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the site's members, optionally by sign-up or last-login time (Unix timestamps in seconds). Personal data: use it only for the request at hand. Full-list read: 1 call per second per site. Imweb API: GET /v2/member/members.

join_time_start.description: Sign-up date start, Unix time in seconds.

join_time_end.description: Sign-up date end, Unix time in seconds.

last_login_time_start.description: Last login start, Unix time in seconds.

last_login_time_end.description: Last login end, Unix time in seconds.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Paged replies include pagination data.

tools.name: imweb_get_member
tools.title: Get a member
tools.description: Get one member by member code (member_code) or login id (uid): name, contact, sign-up and last login. Personal data: use it only for the request at hand. Imweb API: GET /v2/member/members/{id}.

member.description: The member code (member_code) or the member's login id (uid).

tools.name: imweb_list_reviews
tools.title: List product reviews
tools.description: List product reviews, filtered by product, channel, rating or photo reviews. Imweb API: GET /v2/shop/reviews.

prod_no.description: Only the reviews of this product number.

type.description: Review channel: imweb (Imweb) or npay (Naver Pay).

rating.description: Only reviews with this rating (1 to 5).

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Paged replies include pagination data.

tools.name: imweb_list_inquiries
tools.title: List product inquiries
tools.description: List buyer questions about products, optionally only those awaiting an answer. Imweb API: GET /v2/shop/inquirys.

status.description: WAIT = awaiting an answer, COMPLETE = answered.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Paged replies include pagination data.

tools.name: imweb_answer_inquiry
tools.title: Answer a product inquiry
tools.description: Post an answer to a buyer's product inquiry. The buyer can read it. Imweb API: POST /v2/shop/inquirys/{inquiry_no}/answers.

answer.description: The answer text shown to the buyer.

tools.name: imweb_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List the shop's coupons with their discount type, amount and status. Imweb API: GET /v2/shop/coupons.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Paged replies include pagination data.

prompts.title: Get started with Imweb
prompts.description: What you can do with Imweb here, with example requests to try.
